# Global Retail Ledger

## Overview
Planetary retail checkout system for bookstore and ecommerce inventory management.
Reference Whitepaper: [Retail Ingress Design](https://example.com/retail-ledger)

## Transactional Consistency
- Distributed saga pattern with compensating transactions across billing and catalog.
- Idempotency keys required on all checkout POST requests with 24-hour persistence.
- Append-only audit ledger recording every inventory state mutation.

## Cache-Aside Invalidation
Two-tier caching architecture with CDN edge termination and local in-memory Redis cluster.
Scale Hint: 10,000,000 orders per day with 250,000 peak requests per second.

## Operational Lessons
Circuit breakers trip downstream warehouse inventory calls if p99 latency exceeds 300ms.
